SUBJECT:
refactor(web): give the shared RPC transport pieces neutral names
BODY:
The JSONL child process, session driver, handshake result and mapping type
are shared by every RPC-style harness transport (Pi RPC today, the Claude
SDK sidecar next), so they no longer carry Pi names or depend on Pi modules.

- rename PiRpcProcess/PiRpcRecord -> JsonlProcess/JsonlRecord,
  PiRpcSession/PiStep -> RpcSession/RpcStep, PiHandshake/PiModel/PiCommand ->
  RpcHandshake/RpcModel/RpcCommand, PiRpcMapping -> RpcMapping; modules
  pi_rpc_process* -> jsonl_process*, pi_rpc_session* -> rpc_session*
- move the handshake result types to rpc_handshake.rs and RpcMapping into
  rpc_session.rs; the Pi-specific command exchange stays in pi_rpc_handshake
- inject the record mapper into RpcSession::new (RecordMapper) instead of
  importing the Pi mapper; the Pi client passes map_record
- neutral runtime wording in the shared process/session (thread names, id
  prefix, error strings)
- tests: identifier/import-only edits to the existing Pi test files plus a
  new mapper-injection test; no assertion changed
